posts.title: Runtime CSS-in-JS deserves a rehearing
posts.description: Runtime CSS-in-JS has real costs, but runtime-capable systems can solve real composition problems. Their cost should be judged against what they enable.

posts.title: OKHST: predictable color generation for user interfaces
posts.description: OKHST is a tone-based color space for generating UI palettes that behave more predictably across states, dark mode, and high contrast.

posts.title: Why I spent years trying to make CSS states predictable
posts.description: Why predictable CSS state resolution matters, and how Tasty approaches it with state maps and non-overlapping selectors.
